import types
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True, APPEND_SLASH=True, FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME='/script',
    ALLOWED_HOSTS=['*'], SECRET_KEY='x', DATABASES={},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.admin', 'django.contrib.auth',
                    'django.contrib.contenttypes'],
    ROOT_URLCONF='repro_urls',
)
django.setup()

import sys
mod = types.ModuleType('repro_urls')
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.urls import path
mod.urlpatterns = [path('test/', lambda r: HttpResponse('ok'))]
sys.modules['repro_urls'] = mod

from django.contrib.admin import AdminSite
from django.test import RequestFactory

request = RequestFactory().get('/test', SCRIPT_NAME='/script')
print('request.path      =', request.path)
print('request.path_info =', request.path_info)
resp = AdminSite().catch_all_view(request, 'test')
print('redirect target   =', resp['Location'])
assert resp['Location'] == '/script/test/', resp['Location']
print('OK: redirect keeps FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME')
